# A page with a forward-pointing column

The table below is the shape this check judges. Its last column names the issue
that will do the thing, which is what a reader follows to find out whether the
thing has arrived.

| Outcome | What it means | Produced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Accepted` | The code was honoured. | #56 |
| `Refused` | The code was not honoured. | #31, #43 |

A second table with no registered column, so that a fixture proving one leg does
not accidentally prove that the parser only ever finds the first table.

| Setting | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `publicBaseUrl` | empty |
